title: Minibar Cover Rate Applied in the Closing Credit Release
content:
The minibar cover rate used in the closing credit release on a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range is banded by the minibar charges standing on the folio. Where those charges come to 100.00 USD or more, the minibar cover rate is 100 percent. Where they come to 40.00 USD or more but less than 100.00 USD, the minibar cover rate is 75 percent. Where they come to less than 40.00 USD, the minibar cover rate is 50 percent.

The figure banded here is the money total of the minibar charges standing on the folio, taken whoever in the room took them, and not a count of lines.

**Points of judgement.**

*The minibar charges on the folio come to 100.00 USD.* The rate is 100 percent, that figure being the foot of the top band.

*They come to 99.99 USD.* The rate is 75 percent.

*They come to 40.00 USD.* The rate is 75 percent, that figure being the foot of the middle band.

*They come to 39.99 USD.* The rate is 50 percent.

*Four minibar lines stand on the folio coming to 30.00 USD in all.* The rate is 50 percent: the money total governs, not the number of lines.

*The counted minibar figure is 36.00 USD and the minibar charges on the folio come to 120.00 USD.* The rate is 100 percent, so the covered minibar amount is 36.00 USD.

*The counted minibar figure is 36.00 USD and the minibar charges on the folio come to 60.00 USD.* The rate is 75 percent, so the covered minibar amount is 27.00 USD.
